linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no eyelash ticks, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. Draw each hand as a closed outline with each finger as a separate rounded shape. Each head of hair is one closed shape. The ear is one closed outline with at most one inner curve. No lines on the clothes other than the outline, the collar, the cuffs, the buttons, and the pocket. No wrinkle lines on any face. Simplify the background: draw only a few large, simple, closed shapes (the floor line, the wall line, the window as one closed rectangle with each curtain as one closed shape, the sofa as one closed shape with each cushion and each leg as closed shapes, the brown rug and the blue mat as closed ovals, the toy box as one closed box shape with a few big closed toy shapes, the low table as one closed shape with its legs, and the pot as closed shapes: the body, the lid, the knob, and each handle). No wood grain lines, no floor plank lines, no wall texture, no hatching, no tick marks, no small details. Every outline is one closed line that never runs into a background line; no loose line ends anywhere. Every line inside an object ends on another line. Use few background shapes. Mom's wavy hair is one closed cloud-like shape with no strands; her collar, her cuffs, her jeans, and each sneaker are closed shapes. Tom's hair is one closed shape with a side sweep; his T-shirt, shorts, and each shoe are closed shapes. Each hand is one closed outline with five fingers drawn as separate rounded closed shapes (four fingers and one thumb). The top is one closed shape with its yellow stripe as one closed band, its stem and knob as closed shapes, and its point as one closed shape; no motion lines.
